snippet.title: Heidi’s Legacy: Mountains Calling Reveal Trailer | Wholesome Direct 2025
snippet.description: WORLD PREMIERE: Heidi’s Legacy is a story-rich adventure where you care for goats, craft goods, and help villagers rebuild their lives. Explore a world inspired by the Heidi novels, celebrating nature, healing, and the power of community. https://heidi.game #WholesomeDirect #SummerGameFest #IndieGames
